title: Hale Malie | KEY.co
description_expanded: Our stay at this Kauai home was absolutely unforgettable. The ocean views were stunning—like living inside a postcard—and the infinity pool and hot tub were pure bliss. The open layout was perfect for our family, with plenty of space to relax and enjoy the island breeze. We especially loved the outdoor showers, which added a fun, tropical touch. We were initially concerned about a previous review mentioning nearby construction, but it turned out to be a non-issue. The house was always peaceful and felt like our own private retreat. Honestly, we hardly wanted to leave. Whether it was coffee at sunrise or stargazing by the pool, everything about this home felt like paradise. 5 stars! Perched on a lush hillside with sweeping ocean views, Hale Malie is a masterfully designed retreat that captures the soul of Kauai through calm, elegant living. This 7,066-square-foot architectural gem by Shay Zak blends contemporary Hawaiian design with the island’s natural beauty, offering a serene sanctuary where indoor and outdoor spaces flow effortlessly. The great room, anchored by a vaulted redwood ceiling and a window wall facing the Pacific, opens to a vast lanai with an infinity-edge pool, fire bowls, and tiki torches—perfect for evenings bathed in golden sunsets and ocean breezes.
